in_sanskrit.name: Ithika
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Divine, Goddess
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Ithika एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Ithika is a Sanskrit name derived from the word ‘Ishwara’, meaning God or divine. In Hindu mythology, the goddess Ithika is revered as the embodiment of divine love and compassion. She is known to grant blessings of prosperity, happiness, and long life to her devotees.
